data.description: Modern Villa | Close to Amenities | Fully Furnished
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this beautifully maintained and fully furnished 3-bedroom villa located in the highly sought-after community of Amaranta, Villanova.

Designed for comfortable family living, this modern villa offers spacious interiors, elegant furnishings, and a prime location close to community amenities including parks, pools, walking trails, and retail areas.

Perfect for families seeking a peaceful lifestyle within a vibrant and well-connected neighborhood.

Property Features:
⦁ 3 Bedrooms
⦁ Fully Furnished
⦁ Modern Interior Design
⦁ Bright & Spacious Layout
⦁ Private Garden
⦁ Covered Parking
⦁ Balcony/Terrace
⦁ Built-in Wardrobes
⦁ Family-Friendly Community
⦁ Close to Pool, Park & Community Center
⦁ Ready to Move In

Community Highlights:
Villanova is one of Dubai’s most popular family communities, offering landscaped parks, jogging tracks, playgrounds, retail outlets, and easy connectivity to major roads including Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.

For more details or to arrange a viewing, contact Provident Real Estate today.
